raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Claude Code sends `thinking: {"type": "adaptive", "display": "updates"}` on its `/v1/messages?beta=true` requests. `AnthropicThinkingParam.display` only accepts `"summarized"` and `"omitted"`, so the first request of every Claude Code session against sglang fails with:

```
400 invalid_request_error: thinking.display: Input should be 'summarized' or 'omitted'
```

Claude Code then retries without the field, so sessions work, but each one starts with a rejected request.

`"updates"` is a documented Anthropic value, not a client quirk. The anthropic Python SDK defines it on the beta thinking configs:

- `BetaThinkingConfigAdaptiveParam.display: Literal["summarized", "omitted", "updates"]`
- `BetaThinkingConfigEnabledParam.display: Literal["summarized", "omitted", "updates"]`

The non-beta configs list only `"summarized"` and `"omitted"`. The [thinking docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#controlling-thinking-display) describe `"updates"` (beta header `thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18`) as: reasoning blocks come back with an empty `thinking` field, as with `"omitted"`, and only short progress updates between tool calls carry text.

## Modifications

- `entrypoints/anthropic/protocol.py`: `AnthropicThinkingParam.display` accepts `"updates"`. Other values are still rejected, and `display` with `type="disabled"` is still a 400.
- `entrypoints/anthropic/serving.py`: `"updates"` is served like `"omitted"`. Reasoning stays on and its text is still emitted, because the OpenAI-side pipeline cannot blank reasoning blocks or produce progress-update blocks. A warning names the requested value.

Nothing else in Claude Code's opening request needs a change. Replaying the captured request through `AnthropicMessagesRequest` with only `display` adjusted passes validation: `output_config.effort="high"` is already accepted, and `context_management` (`clear_thinking_20251015`) is ignored as an undeclared field.

## Accuracy Tests

Request validation only; generation is unchanged.

Unit tests (`test/registered/unit/entrypoints/anthropic/test_serving.py`):

- `test_request_claude_code_display_updates_is_accepted` uses Claude Code's opening-request shape: adaptive + `display="updates"` + `output_config` + `context_management` + `metadata`. It fails before this change and passes after.
- `test_request_thinking_unknown_display_is_rejected` checks that a value outside the SDK set still fails validation.
- 70 passed.

Live: Claude Code 2.1.296 (`claude -p` with `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` pointing at an sglang server built from this branch, serving `thinkingmachines/Inkling-NVFP4` on 8x H200):
- Both `/v1/messages?beta=true` requests carried `thinking={"type": "adaptive", "display": "updates"}`, and both returned 200. The server log shows 2x 200 and no 400.
- The session completed its tool call and ended with `end_turn`.
- Before this change, the same CLI's first request returned the 400 above.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not performance-related.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -257,28 +257,14 @@ class AnthropicToolChoice(BaseModel):
 class AnthropicThinkingParam(BaseModel):
     """Anthropic extended-thinking control on the request.
 
-    Mirrors the Anthropic SDK's ``ThinkingConfigParam`` discriminated
-    union of three variants — see ``anthropic-sdk-python``'s
-    ``thinking_config_{enabled,disabled,adaptive}_param.py``:
-
-    * ``enabled`` requires ``budget_tokens`` (≥1024) and accepts
-      ``display``.
-    * ``disabled`` accepts no other fields.
-    * ``adaptive`` (Claude 4.7) accepts ``display`` but not
-      ``budget_tokens``.
-
-    The serving layer treats ``adaptive`` identically to ``enabled``
-    because the local OpenAI-compatible backend has no auto-throttle
-    equivalent. ``budget_tokens`` is accepted on ``enabled`` for SDK
-    compatibility but the backend has no hard-cap knob to honor it; the
-    serving layer logs a WARNING so operators see that the requested
-    budget is not enforced. ``display="omitted"`` is accepted but
-    similarly cannot suppress reasoning mid-stream and is logged.
+    Mirrors the SDK's ``thinking_config_{enabled,disabled,adaptive}_param.py``
+    variants. ``budget_tokens`` and ``display="omitted"``/``"updates"`` are
+    accepted for SDK compatibility but not enforced; the serving layer logs them.
     """
 
     type: Literal["enabled", "disabled", "adaptive"]
     budget_tokens: Optional[int] = None
-    display: Optional[Literal["summarized", "omitted"]] = None
+    display: Optional[Literal["summarized", "omitted", "updates"]] = None
 
     @model_validator(mode="after")
     def _validate_thinking_shape(self):

@@ -577,35 +577,22 @@ def _emit_user_message(parts: list[dict]) -> None:
         chat_request = ChatCompletionRequest(**request_data)
 
         if anthropic_request.thinking is not None:
-            # The protocol layer already enforces SDK shape:
-            #   enabled  -> budget_tokens required (>=1024), display optional
-            #   disabled -> neither budget_tokens nor display allowed
-            #   adaptive -> budget_tokens forbidden, display optional
-            # So by the time we get here ``budget_tokens`` can only be
-            # set on ``enabled``. The local backend has no equivalent
-            # hard-cap knob, so we log a WARNING instead of rejecting —
-            # the Anthropic SDK would have accepted the request and we
-            # mirror that. Operators see the unenforced budget in logs.
             if anthropic_request.thinking.budget_tokens is not None:
                 logger.warning(
                     "Anthropic thinking.budget_tokens=%d is accepted for "
                     "SDK compatibility but the local backend has no "
                     "equivalent hard-cap knob — the budget is not enforced",
                     anthropic_request.thinking.budget_tokens,
                 )
-            # Claude 4.7's ``adaptive`` is treated identically to ``enabled``
-            # because the local backend has no auto-throttle equivalent.
-            # Anything other than ``disabled`` enables reasoning.
+            # The backend has no adaptive throttle, so ``adaptive`` runs as ``enabled``.

-            if anthropic_request.thinking.display == "omitted":
-                # Anthropic 4.7 spec: keep reasoning ON but hide reasoning
-                # text from the client. The OpenAI streaming pipeline has
-                # no equivalent suppress knob — log so operators can see
-                # the request, then proceed with normal reasoning emission.
+            display = anthropic_request.thinking.display
+            if display in ("omitted", "updates"):
                 logger.warning(
-                    "Anthropic thinking.display='omitted' is accepted for "
+                    "Anthropic thinking.display=%r is accepted for "
                     "SDK compatibility but reasoning text will still be "
-                    "emitted to the client"
+                    "emitted to the client",
+                    display,
                 )
             self.openai_serving_chat.apply_reasoning_enabled(chat_request, enabled)
